test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In how much time will ₹5,000 amount to ₹6,800 at a simple interest of 9% per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 5000

Rate = 9%

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

S.I = Amount - P

Here, P = Sum, T = Time, R = Rate 

**Calculation:**

S.I = 6800 - 5000 = 1800

Let the time be T

According to the question,

1800 = (5000 × T × 9)/100

⇒ 450T = 1800

⇒ T = 1800/450 = 4

**∴ The required time is 4 years.**
